title: 黄仁勋风格转保守：循环融资少了高调推手，AI热潮还推得下去吗？
speaker: Felix Wang

segments.en: Okay, so remain on the sidelines. Don't buy on this, Deb. As you say, right?
segments.zh: 好的，那就继续观望。Deb，别因为这个买入。就像你说的，对吧？

segments.en: The stock has only recovered just, I mean, half maybe, of the market cap that was really wiped out since the scandal broke out 11 days ago.
segments.zh: 这只权益资产只收复了自11天前丑闻爆发以来真正蒸发掉的市值的大约一半。

segments.en: What does it mean for, in terms of just moving for what this company is going to look like, right?
segments.zh: 就这家公司未来的走向而言，这意味着什么？

segments.en: We just had some of our analysts come on saying, this is not gonna be the same Jensen Huang with the leather jacket with the studs, right?
segments.zh: 我们的一些分析师刚说，这不会是那个穿铆钉皮衣的黄仁勋了，对吧？

segments.en: I mean, it might be much more refined or I guess conservative Jensen Huang moving forward.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，未来的黄仁勋可能会更加内敛，或者说更加保守。

segments.en: What does this mean for some of the circular financing deals that he was pushing and obviously was an advocate for moving, and how is that gonna look moving forward here
segments.zh: 这对他在推动并公开倡导的一些循环融资交易意味着什么？未来在AI热潮中会如何演变？

segments.en: Well, it's better to have Jensen, they're not have Jensen as a real audience to the circular financing, also the neo-cloud commitments that we're very close to.
segments.zh: 嗯，有黄仁勋在场，而不是让他成为循环融资的真正对象，这更好，还有我们非常接近的新云承诺。

segments.en: I think that's why you have rallies in names like Qualweb, Nibbius and others today.
segments.zh: 我认为这就是今天Qualweb、Nibbius等权益资产上涨的原因。

segments.en: But I do think Jensen is gonna be a little bit more conservative than his outspoken nature just because, again,
segments.zh: 但我确实认为，黄仁勋会比他直言不讳的性格稍微保守一些，因为，再次强调，

segments.en: the investigations are still ongoing and he needs to be careful, he doesn't shine too much spotlight on some things
segments.zh: 调查仍在进行中，他需要谨慎行事，避免在某些事情上引起过多关注

segments.en: that may be construed as too risky.
